body:
I may have explained more what I had in mind.

So:
- community.algolia.com <=> algolia.github.io  (CNAME): SEO purpose
- the Github project top link will go to: http://(community.algolia.com|algolia.github.io)/intantsearch.js
- the live-documentation is the list of widgets, it's the main/simple documentation hosted on the website. Yes this one was in `feat/live-doc` that @bobylito bootstarted
- the jsdoc will be linked from the website menu as well but it's a reference documentation: only used by advanced users
- the instant search demo should really stay in the Algolia.com's tutorial, we'll not link to it here. Or at least not in the "main" links

> What will be the use of the built-in search for the live documentation website?

To search for widgets, themes and all other sections we'll have.
